summary: Goldgroup Mining filed a Form 6-K (Canadian equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) reporting a non-brokered private placement, upsized on September 14, 2026 from US$75M to US$125M. Units are priced at US$3.65, each comprising one common share and one-half of a warrant exercisable at US$5.10 for 18 months. Cornerstone commitments include Trafigura, Eric Sprott, Rick Rule and others, with US$60M already committed. Closing is expected on or about September 30, 2026, subject to TSXV and NYSE American approvals. Watch for final subscription levels and any warrant overhang.
